test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Editing involves ______ and correction with an intention to produce accurate work.
solution:
The correct answer is '**modification**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most suitable word for the statement is '**modification**' as the sentence means to express the value of Editing which involves **modification** and **correction.**
 
• The word '**modification**' means the act or process of **changing parts of something.**

So, **modification** tries to justify the statement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's look at the other options,

 
• **Habitation** means** living **in a** place**,
 
• **Fortification** means **wall** or **tower** to **protect oneself**,
 
• **Modulation** means an** inflection** of the** tone** or **pitch** of the **voice**.
